sources.title: kobimusic
sources.snippet: kobimusic is no longer that app; it's a collection of ai-music projects of mine with the goal being to 'empower the musicians' (i know, vague corporate mission; bear with me).

sources.title: KobiMusic | AI MIDI generator by hidude562
sources.snippet: AI MIDI generator Also check out The kobimusic web music generator KobiMusic KobiMusic is an easy to use AI MIDI generator with a friendly GUI. You can prompt it with your own/others' MIDI files and can get a relatively coherent completion to it. sources.title: Devlog - KobiMusic | AI MIDI generator by hidude562
sources.snippet: Long gone are the days of Musenet, an AI midi generator by OpenAI in 2019 for a blog post, later shutdown in early 2023. It used GPT-2 for its basic architecture.
